forecast_origin_convention: End of day t, after day t weather observations are available
row_assignment: Assign each forecast row independently for each horizon using its target date
missing_target_policy: Exclude missing target values from the corresponding horizon-specific training or evaluation dataset
feature_history_policy: Historical predictor observations may cross the development and holdout origin-date boundary when available at forecast origin
holdout_policy: Do not use final holdout data for feature selection, hyperparameter tuning, or model selection
validation_period_note: A separate chronological validation period within development must be defined before model selection
